root.title: payload body
root.description: Exports the specified document block as Markdown

addTitle.description: Whether to add the document title at the beginning, the export setting is used by default

adjustHeadingLevel.description: Whether to adjust heading levels when exporting a block (starting from level 1)

embedMode.description:
Export mode of embed blocks, the export setting is used by default
- `0`: Original text
- `1`: Blockquote

fillCSSVar.description: Whether to replace theme CSS variables in inline styles with their values

imgTag.description: Whether to export images as `img` tags

refMode.description:
Export mode of block references, the export setting is used by default
- `2`: Anchor text with a link to the block
- `3`: Anchor text only
- `4`: Anchor text with a footnote

yfm.description: Whether to add YAML Front Matter
